lines.en: : Hah...fuck it.
I sigh to myself as I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone- knowing that, unless sudden tragedy has struck (Which wouldn’t be too uncommon around here) that she’s a package deal now.
That’s right, imaginary audience that I talk to all the time for reasons both you and I don’t understand — somehow Kaori managed to track down the only other person in Kumon-mi with heterochromia.
Or, as she refers to it, special eyes.
For Kaori, I’m not sure if I’d go that far as, unless I’m misremembering what little of her backstory I’ve been able to discern, she’s always looked like that.
Nao is...
Well, let’s just say I’m still having a hard time accepting that we just randomly discovered a little girl with eyes matching Ami and Maya for no reason whatsoever.
There’s something more to this, just...
The chances of me ever figuring that out while Nao can’t talk and Kaori can’t talk well are very slim.
But hey, maybe Kaori’s been doing an exemplary job as a “mothermom” in my absence and Nao has suddenly evolved or something.
Like always, there’s only one way to find out.
: Shh!
: Your talk-voice must not be big when there are word-drenched paper blocks present!
: Are you...at the library?
: Incorrect! I collected my own knowledge blocks and am helping Nao-chan memorize the best words! Like “greyscale” or “muskrat!” And having a big voice will make the words dissolve!
: Ahh, yes. I forgot that’s why silence is heavily enforced in libraries. It has nothing to with disturbing anyone.
: You are forgotten.
: You mean “forgiven.”
: Who are you?
: Or maybe you don’t.
: Hello!
: Kaori, I’m not waiting for you to invite me any longer. I’m coming over.
: But I am being you — a human teacher for small girl who needs my help!
: Then you won’t mind if I come check your progress. No one is a better authority on me than myself. Or maybe Ami. Or Maya. Or Niki.
: Cotton candy girl! Are her legs still where they’re meant to be?
: Yeah, she’s doing fine. But we can talk more about her when I get to your place.
: But Nao-chan-
I hang up the phone and begin to make my way over to Kaori’s apartment in a much better mood than I’ve been the last several times I’ve gone there.
And no, it has nothing to do with the fact that I’m getting two potential aliens for the price of one.
But it has everything to do with how things have been looking up lately.
I love my niece and all of the things she does.
I love my childhood friend slash ex-girlfriend slash idol and how she’s helping me learn to walk again.
And I’m closer to Maya than ever before.
Well, in this life at least. From what I understand, I’ve been very close to her in the past.
It’s all smiles and sunshine for me.
Nothing can possibly go wrong.
Nothing can possibly go wrong.
Nothing can possibly go wrong.
Tonight is going to be a good night.
This is a feeling I have which means that it must be true because it is a feeling I have it is a feeling I have it is a feeling I have and I have this feeling that I have and it’s going to be good.
There are nineteen different ways to brew coffee (That I am aware of).
I will now tell you about them.
Just kidding lol.
: And that combination of letters means “dodgeball!” It is a game where you dodge a ball! Do you understand, Nao-chan?
: Hi Kaori. I promise that nothing followed me on the way here.
: Friendtruder! You entered the housing-cube so very quietly! I am impressed by your ability to remain undetected! Are you the ninja?
: Yes, that is me. How go Nao’s apparent lessons? Is she able to read yet?
: No! But it is the thinking that counts and if you think hard enough you can count every number there is!
: I only wish there were better fruits to teach her with as this mango is both not edible and has too many pictures of females in tiny skirts.
: Manga. Not a fruit. And it would probably be best to teach her with actual books rather than comics.
: Oh, great. You’ve already got her hooked on them, haven’t you?
: Nao-chan loves the picture mango. It is her favorite fruit that isn’t a fruit but is still a fruit because the mango is a fruit.
: As long as she doesn’t turn into another Molly, I’m sure it will be fine.
: Would you like to assist me in the reformatting of the Nao-chan brain, Friendtruder? You have more experience with this than I do and understand so many more words.
: Maybe another time. I feel suddenly compelled to go outside with you while leaving Nao inside to read on her own.
: That does not sound like an effective means of instruction.
: I’m sure she’ll be fine. I just really think we should go outside.
: Nothing followed me here.
: This is the one-plus-oneth time you have mentioned being followed. If there is a wild human animal outside, all you need to do is make yourself look large and it will likely run away.
: It is human nature to run away from things that are much bigger than you. That is why I avoid the long-necked wrong-horse.
: There’s nothing here. Nothing followed me.
: Why are you suddenly the strange one? That is my occupation.
: Let’s go outside.
: Nao-chan, be the good girl and eat your mango while I talk to Friend. But eat with knowledge and not your mouth bones. This is not that kind of mango.
: Come, Friend! But have the quickness! Show me what did not or did follow you!
: Nothing followed me. I already told you that. Stop being so weird.
: It appears that you did not fill your pockets with deceit before arriving here.
: Do you really think I’d lie to you? What would I have to gain from that?
: My collection of circular earth-bits so you can defend yourself from whatever furry non-friend follows you next. Is that your main fear, friend? Because mine is the color green.
: I’m not after your rock collection. I just wanted to spend some time with you away from Nao.
: Do you not like Nao-chan? Because Nao-chan is the good girl. She does the good things and will one day become the good woman.
: I don’t have a problem with her. It took me a little to warm up to you as well. But tonight, I just felt like I should be with you. That’s all.
: You felt...like you should be with me?
: Why?
: It’s just a feeling. I don’t really know how to describe it.
: Hot face!
: Yeah, you’re blushing pretty intensely all of a sudden.
: I apologize for changing colors. I understand humans should not do that and you are probably scared. But I will not hurt you the way you are afraid wild animals will.
: I’m not afraid of wild animals. In fact, I’m not really afraid of anything. I just wanted you to know that I am here alone and that I want to be with you while you are also alone.
: But if you are the alone and I am also the alone does that not mean we are together? Or is that another kind of alone? Like mango and mango.
: Please just talk to me. About anything. I don’t want to be home right now. It’s not safe.
: Not safe?...
: It isn’t safe anywhere. Everywhere I go I see her and I don’t want to see her and I don’t want to remember and I know I have to but I can’t and I don’t want to and you don’t understand any of that-
: Which is why I’m here. Please keep me company. I’m not afraid of anything, I swear.
: I understand.
: The Queen of Spiders will let you rest in her web — but only under one condition.
: And that condition is?
: That you tell me who you’re running from.
: What? No. What? Why?
: Friend? What seems to be the problemo? That is the Spain word for “problem.” You’ll never guess where they say that.
: Your eyes...they...
: They are special and made of a clear, jelly-like collagen.
: They help me see things and sometimes they get all ahhhhhh when I am awake for longer than I should be.
: What more would you like to know about them?
: You’re not...
: Who...
: Who...are you?...
: I am Kaori! The Queen of Spiders! The Mistress of the Dark! The greatest waitress in all of Kumon-mi!
: But most importantly, I am your-
: Huh?
: My fleshy exterior feels very tingly all of a sudden.
ARE YOU READY?!
GOOD!!!
THEN COUNT IT DOWN WITH ME!
M!
Parrot!
Nothing!
Circle!
And most importantly...
T!
Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!
: Mm! Mmf! Mm!
It increased again!
: Mm! Mmnch! Mmf!!
And again!
: Nngh! Mmf! Mmnch! Mmm!
Wow!
: Mm! Mmmm! Mm! Chm! Chmp! Mnch! Mm!
She must really like kissing!
: Mmf! Mmm! Mnch!!! Mmm!!!
: Hah...hah...hah...
: More...
: What the fuck is-
: Ngh!
: F...Friend!
: I...can’t...stop!
: Kaori-
: 月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
I’m not sure how long this goes on for.
And, to be even more honest, I’m not even sure if it’s really happening right now or not.
I’m obviously no stranger to nonsensical scenarios, but this is really just way too much.
It came out of nowhere.
The mood is all wrong.
And yet...
And yet her tongue is like novocaine.
It kills off all the pain and makes me numb.
I needed that tonight.
It came in a different way than I expected it to, and who knows if it will ever come again...
But for now-
I close my eyes and kiss her back.
Because I’m not just content with feeling numb-
I prefer it.
This is normal for me.
This is what I’m meant to be.
Confused.
Afraid.
And with my tongue in a pretty girl’s mouth.
Speaking nothing, feeling nothing.
That’s all I’ll ever be.
That’s all I’ll ever want.
: Mm! Mmnch! Mm...
: Mm! Hngh! Mmch! Chmp! Chmm!
: Mm! Mnff! Mmngh! Mmm!!!
I wonder if I should stop her.
The moments leading up to this are expectedly blurry but, I can’t imagine any world in which Kaori would willingly throw herself at me like this out of nowhere.
And that means a lot since I have seen several worlds at this point and am becoming a bit of an expert when it comes to them.
: Mm...mmmngh! Mmnch!
Yeah...I should probably stop this.
Especially now that we have a spectator.
: Kaori.
: Huh? What? Huh?
: Why the closeness?! And the hot face again?! And why does my mouth muscle have more wetness than the normal amount of wetness it normally has?!
: I imagine it's because you just forced yourself on me.
: What...did I do? What does “force yourself” mean?
: It can mean a number of things. But in this case, you pushed me up against the wall and starting making out with me.
: You can not make “out,” Friend. Out is a direction. Please explain the situation with different words because one second things were normal things but the next they were red and bubbly things!
: You kissed me. And quite aggressively at that.
: Kiss?...
: You do know what a kiss is, correct?
: Yes. But we are friends. We can not do the kiss. That would make us special friends and I do not want to make a new human yet.
: It takes a little more than kissing to do that, just FYI.
: I understand human mating rituals. What I do not understand is why there would be a kiss. This is not a thing I would do. I don’t want a special friend.
: First off, harsh. Second, I’m not going to hold it against you. I’ve been in a...similar situation once before.
: How did that “situation” end?
: The girl it happened with wound up rightfully despising me for the rest of...forever. She hasn’t really stopped yet.
: Does this mean you are you going to despise me?! For the accident?!
: An accident is just that. I won’t hold it against you.
: But you might want to back off for now since your daughter is watching us.
: A baby was already formed?! Maybe I do not understand mating rituals at all!
: I’m talking about Nao...
: Ahh! Nao-chan! Shield your vision balls! You are not yet prepared to see the scary things large humans do!
Kaori sends Nao back inside and...I suppose we’ve reached the part of the night where she apologizes for what happened and then heads back in herself.
The thing is, she doesn’t need to apologize.
If anything, I should be thanking her as that spontaneous make out session was somehow able to set me back on the right course.
When I told you things have been looking up, I was lying.
I’m sure that’s obvious in hindsight, but you need to see this from my perspective to truly understand.
It wasn’t obvious for me.
It isn’t obvious now either.
Because while the residual effects of a novocaine tongue still linger in my mouth, I know better than anyone that numbness is only temporary.
And as soon as I walk away from this apartment, even that will start to fade.
Something did follow me here.
You can’t see it.
But I can.
: The cotton candy girl will not be happy with the kiss that I have done.
: She is the one you should be doing this kissing with.
: Do you...talk to her often?
: Only when she has a wiener in her mouth.
: She says many words about you. And you would form an attractive human together if you mated.
: Are we still allowed to be friends?
: Why wouldn’t we be?
: Because there is an invisible line humans always talk about and I can not see it because it is invisible but, if I could, I think I would have stepped over it when I did the kiss.
: It was an accident. I don’t even remember the line. The world just changed all of a sudden and when my sight-spheres became normal sight-spheres again, you were right in front of me.
: I’m sorry. It won’t happen again.
: It...can if you want it to.
: Why would I want it to? I don’t understand.
: You are Friend, not Special Friend. Repeating the kiss with you will give you a new name and you do not like the new names you receive.
: True. But I liked kissing you. Even if it...wasn’t really my decision.
: What about it did you like?
: I mean...that’s not really a question that’s easy to answer. I just did.
: I’m sorry for asking a difficult question. I just do not possess any memories of it and wanted to see if I could have your memories move into my brain and build a thought-house there.
: On second thought, yeah. Maybe it’s better if we don’t do that again.
: Yes. Now we are reading the same page.
: Can your legs take you to the place you need to go next? Or will one of them run away?
: I’m sure I’ll get home fine. Apologies in advance for all of the questions Nao will have for you, though.
: Nao-chan does not ask questions. She has not learned that yet. But I will add mating and courting rituals to the list of things she needs to make brain-room for.
: Yeah, maybe wait a few years before you give her all of the details. But I’ll get out of your hair now. I’ve fucked up your night more than enough already.
: All you did was make my heart go babababa and that is not a bad thing. But it is a thing. And now I have to wait for the babababa to stop.
: I will be in my housebox if you need me.
: And if you ever think something is behind you, remember to make yourself look big.
: The world is scary when you are small.
: That is why the fieldmice hide.
